text: 乙方被迫当上“房东”，房企供应商深陷“工抵房”困局 在房地产风险传导链条中，供应商面临如何消化工抵房的难题。
text_en: Suppliers forced to become 'landlords', real estate suppliers mired in 'property-for-debt' dilemma: In the risk transmission chain of the real estate sector, suppliers face the challenge of digesting properties obtained in lieu of cash payments
